Understanding prayer times in Khartoum

Khartoum uses the Egyptian convention available in Salati and Africa/Khartoum time. The coordinates represent central Khartoum rather than a combined timetable for Omdurman, Khartoum North or the rest of Sudan. The weekly table shows how times change between days. Choose your own city in the app when outside the centre, and check the mosque timetable when calculations differ.

Sunrise is not an obligatory prayer. The mosque sets iqamah, which may follow adhan. The main app lets you change calculation method, Asr convention and location settings.
